recipes.name: Amazing Southwest Cilantro Lime Mango Grilled Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients_raw: 2 tablespoons finely grated fresh lime zest
0.25 jalapeno chile pepper, seeded and minced
1 pound chicken breast tenderloins or strips
0.5 jalapeno chile pepper, seeded and minced

steps.text: Combine 1/4 cup cilantro, lime zest, 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1/4 jalapeño, 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, 1 clove minced garlic, onion powder, 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, and 1/4 teaspoon chipotle chile powder in a small bowl until well mixed; pour into a large resealable plastic bag. Add chicken tenderloins to the bag, coat with marinade, squeeze out excess air, and seal the bag. Marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour.

Meanwhile, combine 1 chopped onion, tomato, 2 tablespoons cilantro, 1/2 jalapeño, 1 tablespoon lime juice, 1 clove finely chopped garlic, 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, 1/4 teaspoon sea salt, and 1/8 teaspoon chipotle chile powder in a bowl. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate salsa until chilled.
Toss 1 sliced onion, bell pepper quarters, 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1/2 teaspoon minced garlic, and 1/4 teaspoon salt together in a bowl; set aside.
Whisk mayonnaise and 2 tablespoons lime juice together; cover lime mayonnaise with plastic wrap and refrigerate to chill.
Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat and lightly oil the grate.

Grill chicken on the preheated grill until no longer pink in centers and juices run clear, 8 to 10 minutes. Grill onion slices and bell pepper quarters until tender and golden brown, 8 to 10 minutes. Transfer chicken and vegetables to a cutting board; keep grill lit. Slice pepper quarters into thin strips.

Spread each bread slice with 1 1/2 teaspoons lime mayonnaise. Layer half bread slices with mango, 1 tablespoon salsa, chicken, pepper strips, sliced onions, and 1 slice Monterey Jack cheese; top each with 1 bread slice.
Grill sandwiches on the preheated grill until bread is toasted and cheese melts, about 2 minutes per side.

review.reviewBody: for flavor, this recipe definitely gets five stars, but for the complicated and time consuming directions I'm only going to give it four. Just mix the mangoes in with the salsa and instead of grilling the entire sandwhich just grill the bread alongside everything else. This recipe is also really good with fish, especially ahi. I also added wasabi to the mayo ( I used veggie mayo) and it was really yummy!

As others have noted, the flavor of this sandwich is amazing, but somewhat time-consuming to make. I've made it several times and it's much easier to add the mango into the salsa, does not detract from the flavor at all. I usually grill the chicken indoors and then cut into thin slices to make it easier to eat. I've tried different kinds of bread and have decided my favorite is a Kaiser roll. I slice the top off and hollow out the bottom part so I have a "boat" to put everything in. I use one chicken breast and half the salsa recipe and it makes four to six Kaiser sandwiches. I put the sandwich under the broiler for a minute or two to melt the cheese but watch out! The first time I made this the cheese caught on fire! Also, I only add a couple of teaspoons of lime juice to the mayo, not Tbsp. as listed and add a sprinkle of chili powder as well.

This was so good! I made the salsa and marinated the chicken the day before. It was too cold outside for grilling, so I just baked the chicken in the oven, grilled the veggies on the stove and toasted the bread. I added the diced mango to the salsa. After the chicken was cooked, I topped it with the veggies and cheese and put it back in the oven until it melted. then added the salsa. I will definitely be making this again!

Restaurant quality. I made as written except I used colby jack cheese and served on kaiser rolls. I also used my oven instead of a grill. These were time consuming and quite messy, but absolutely delicious. Fantastic, I'd say.

Next time, I'll dice the mango and put it in with the salsa, but that is the only change I'll make. I baked the chicken at 450 for about 20 minutes and it is good enough on its own to be a main dish, so I will likely use the chicken part of the recipe for other dishes, as well. 

The hubs demands I put this into the rotation, and I do believe it's earned a spot :-)

I am the recipe submitter. I use a food processor and one of those chopping gadgets to do most of the complicated prep work and I prep all of the veggies at the same time. It goes quicker than you think with these tools. I usually bake the bread the day before. If I need to save time I buy the Dole mango strips in the jar from the produce section and buy the stores french loaves and already sliced cheese from the deli. Red pepper and onions are cut into strips like for fajitas and grilled in a veggi grill basket. They can also be broiled in the oven. The key is to get that caramelizing around the edges of the vegetables.

This recipe literally had my taste buds dancing in my mouth!!!
Being a short order cook, I simplified the recipe for the kitchen. Do yourself a favor and keep the recipe simple by using dried cilantro flakes, a jar of jalapeño slices, lime juice from the plastic lime (lol!), minced garlic from a jar (produce section), sautée the chicken and veggies in a skillet together, use flatbread ( your choice), and use shredded cheese. 
 I doubled the marinade to provide enough coverage for the chicken. I then sautéed the chicken and veggies in the same skillet over medium high heat to save time and mess. Like others, I used flatbread ( or tortillas or pita bread) instead of french bread. The flatbread saved the pain of grilling and worrying about this marvelous recipe falling into the fire. I also diced the mango and put into the salsa. I used shredded cheese to keep it simple. To finish, I used a thin spread of the lime mayo on the bread, added the chicken and veggies and topped with salsa and shredded cheese. 
It's been a hit every time I made it!!!

This was outrageously delicious and my husband immediately asked that I keep this recipe handy!!! I saw the other comments that it was messy on bread and thought about doing it in tortillas, but he's not a big taco guy, so I just served it as chicken dinner without the carbs! Worked marvelously...we topped the chicken with the cheese and grilled veggies on top of that with mango slices alongside. Fabulous!

I made this recipe for my 5 person family and it was a major hit! Even my 10 year old cousin loved it. Though this dish takes a lot of time and energy, it is worth it in the end. All of the flavors work wondrously together! I would have expected to find this on a restaurant menu.
I had to slightly tweak the recipe, however, because we could not get a hold of any French bread. We made these into wraps using tortillas. Also, we do not have a working grill so we sauteed the vegetables and chicken on the stove. Even with this, it was delicious! I'm sure it is even better with the grill and bread!

Amazing? YEP!!!! I asked my son: If you were at a restaurant, would you order this again? His response -- no doubt...on the same night!

Didn't quite follow the recipe exactly but not completely on purpose. Intentionally used a couple+ tablespoons of jarred chipotle peppers instead of the chipotle chili powder in both the marinade and the salsa. YUM! Not on purpose, forgot to tell hubby to pick up cilantro at the grocery store so we didn't have that -- can't wait to include it next time. Also cooked the fully sliced onions and red peppers on the grill in a grill pan -- perfect! 

The only thing I will do different next time (other than add the cilantro) is chop the mangos PLUS chunk some fresh avocado and add them both to the salsa. The mango, monterey jack cheese and avocado help cut down on the heat -- oh so many AMAZING flavors! I would also recommend grilling the bread with the cheese to get it all nice and gooey so nothing falls out! 

Yes it is a little time consuming to prepare -- if preparing for a crowd (total pleaser, btw) most could be done in advance -- thankfully both my son and hubby helped so it wasn't too bad for dinner tonight. 

P.S. If you are a chipotle fan, try the Chipotle Crusted Pork Tenderloin from this site and sub the chili powder for the canned chili's and I promise you won't be disappointed!

Very yummy. Four stars as it takes a fair amount of work, yet isn't fancy for company. I served to good friends and they liked it and didn't mind the messiness. O itted cheese as I didn't have it. Diced mango instead of slices and grilled bread, but not entire sandwich. Had all items on table, allowing guests to make own sandwich and choose how much of each ingredient to include or to eat separately. Next time I might sub a freshly made salsa or brand like Salsa Lisa from the store as the salsa in this recipe is fairly standard and add in the chipotle to get smokiness with less work. I might make this as a chicken salad, dicing up the chicken and grilled veg, to make it easier to eat.

I tweaked this recipe a bit; I used a prepared Mexican marinade to save time, and I put it on sundried tomato-basil wraps instead of bread. My family loved it! My sister, who eats out several times a week, said it was restaurant quality! I used both light and dark meat chicken, and I cut it into strips before cooking to save a step, and took it off the grill just as soon as the largest strip wasn't pink. I only used one mango (didn't write down my shopping list-again) it was subtle and sweet, next time I'll use two. Had the salsa on the side, to reduce the mess. Definately will make again!
Really tasty sandwich. My new favorite. The flavors come together perfectly!
We loved this! Used nuns instead of French bread because that’s what I had. Delicious!

Thank you for submitting this recipe. It was delicious. Enjoyed by my toddler on up to the adults. I subbed chicken thighs for the breasts, because they tend to be juicer when grilled. This recipe was great. We ate the sandwiches on ciabatta rolls. Although it was time consuming to prep, the end result was definitely worth it!
These sandwiches are amazing.The recipe is easy to follow and the result is delicious.They are packed with flavor and awesomeness.

This is the most delicious sandwich I’ve ever eaten! It’s a lot of work, but totally worth it! If you enjoy sharing the cooking experience with someone, this is a great recipe for allowing two people to complete different steps at the same time. Get into the kitchen/out to the grill and have some fun!!
Wow, this was great! Used shallots instead of sweet onions and provalone instead of jack cheese and made it hoogie style. Great recipe, I will definitely do it again

The mango was just sweet enough to balance the spicy, and the chicken and grilled peppers held their own too. I've made this recipe several times with different variations and I recommend sticking to the recipe. There are a lot of flavors and they all complement each other.
This was fantastic. I made some changes, but nothing significant . I will definitely make this again.

Made this exactly as written except baked the chicken and vegetables instead of grilling for 35 minutes at 375. I also used rolls instead of French bread. This was an amazing sandwich. So many flavors! Lots of steps but worth it
